headline: Agility Robotics, maker of the Digit humanoid robot, has cleared a key US regulatory step toward becoming a listed company through a merger with a blank-check firm.
score_reason: Pool score 7 kept: the first planned stock-market listing of a pure humanoid robot maker moves forward; the 2 Nov 2026 vote is still ahead and the claims are the company's own.
importance_line: If shareholders approve the deal, investors would get what Agility calls the only US publicly listed pure-play humanoid robot company with proven commercial deployments, but that description and the deployment record come from Agility's own release, and the deal still needs the vote and other closing conditions.
summary: Agility Robotics said in a Business Wire release that the US Securities and Exchange Commission declared effective on 13 Oct 2026 the registration statement for its merger with Churchill Capital Corp XI, a blank-check company (a listed shell formed to buy a business), and that Churchill XI shareholders will vote on the deal on 2 Nov 2026. The companies expect more than $620 million in gross proceeds, including about $424 million in the shell's trust account if no shareholders redeem and about $200 million from a private share sale led by Foxconn, and Agility says it would trade on Nasdaq as AGLT after closing, expected in November 2026.
notes: Read from the pool fulltext: the Business Wire release as carried by FinancialContent (the original Business Wire link was not in the pool, so the URL is the FinancialContent page). Company press release, so business claims are Agility's own. Same story as C11-07 (Unite.AI): hold one as duplicate. Not in the 10, 11 and 12 Oct pools.
